bends.note: corner: Fairview comes in E-W from the east and turns SSW (60' both legs); Zigzag Ts into the outside of the corner
angle point: E-W leg turns NE (about 34 deg) toward McMillan on sheet 250; South View's north leg meets the corner here
L corner: South View runs east from Fairview, then turns a right angle north to rejoin Fairview at its NE angle (no continuation east)

notes: Names printed without a suffix (ADA, WARNER) are written with 'Street'; W. McMillan written 'West McMillan Street' as on 255. ZIGZAG AV. is printed ZIGZAG (not Ziegzag/Ziegler). W. McMillan (lines y~228/575, 60') runs from the right edge west to Zigzag and is closed at x~3005; Zigzag (50') comes up from Fairview and turns into McMillan's west end (L corner, recorded as T at the centreline crossing). West of x~3005 above the y~385 lot line the sheet is blank (no street drawn), matching 248 where McMicken's east line is unbroken there. Fairview/Zigzag: the three centrelines (Fairview E-W, Fairview SSW, Zigzag) form a small triangle (3810,2057)/(3757,2057)/(3795,2128); the junction point is its middle. South View Avenue is L-shaped: E-W leg (lines y~2913/3220) from Fairview's SSW leg east to x~5800, then a 50' N-S leg (lines x~5640/5955) north to Fairview's NE angle; the N-S leg carries no separate name on the sheet (the key map writes VIEW along it), so both legs are 'South View Avenue'. Ada and South View both end at Fairview on the west (T; only lot lines west of Fairview). Ada continues east off the sheet onto 250. Fairview continues south across Warner onto 237 (cross); Warner continues west onto 248 and east onto 250. The dash-dot lines lettered A/B (x~5770) and C/D (x~650) are boundary lines, not streets.
